name: Draft
description: Context-Driven Development: draft specs and plans before implementation. Structured workflows for features and fixes.
longDescription:
Ships **33 skills**.

- **Skills** (33): `adr` (Create and manage Architecture Decision Records), `assist-review` (Reviewing someone else's PR for handoff/sign-off), `bughunt` (Performs an exhaustive 14-dimension bug hunt across the codebase using Draft context (architecture, tech-stack, product) for false-positive elimination), `change` (Handle mid-track requirement changes), `coverage` (Compute code coverage for active track or module), `debug` (Structured debugging session), `decompose` (Decompose project or track into modules with dependency mapping), `deep-review` (Single-module production readiness audit (ACID, resilience, observability)), and 25 more

Installs with `claude plugin install draft@claude-community` from `mayurpise/draft`.
